title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 8（2026-11-05）
summary: 今天的專項是假設語氣：Part 5 前 5 題只練「看主要子句決定 if 子句時態」，後面 7 題複習連接詞與介系詞、whose／who、find + 受詞 + 形容詞、comply with。聽力換成 Part 3 兩人對話。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績，昨天的 Day 7 還沒交卷的話也請一起做完交卷。

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: 假設語氣只看一件事：主要子句。will + 原形 → if 用現在式；would + 原形 → if 用過去式（be 動詞用 were）；would have + p.p. → if 用 had + p.p.。

qs.stem: If I ------- you, I would ask the manager for help.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 看主要子句：I would ask ＝ would + 原形 → 和現在事實相反（我不是你）。2. 與現在相反的 if 子句用過去式，be 動詞一律用 were。3. 選 were。口訣：If I were you, I would…，整句背起來。

qs.stem: If we had more time, we ------- visit the museum.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. if 子句是 had（過去式）→ 與現在事實相反（其實沒時間）。2. 主要子句用 would + 原形。3. 選 would。will 是「真的有可能」的條件句，要配 If we have more time。

qs.stem: If the bus ------- on time yesterday, we would have arrived before the meeting.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 看到 yesterday 和 would have arrived ＝ 過去沒發生的事。2. 與過去相反的 if 子句用 had + p.p.。3. 選 had come。對照公式：If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.。

qs.stem: If Ms. Lin had checked the e-mail, she ------- the mistake.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. if 子句是 had checked（had + p.p.）→ 與過去相反。2. 主要子句一定是 would have + p.p.。3. 選 would have noticed。兩邊要成對：had + p.p. 配 would have + p.p.。

qs.stem: If it ------- tomorrow, the outdoor concert will be canceled.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句是 will be canceled（will）→ 不是假設，是真的可能發生。2. 一般條件句：if 子句用現在式，就算講的是 tomorrow 也一樣。3. 選 rains。看主要子句：will → 現在式；would → 過去式；would have → had + p.p.。

qs.stem: The flight was delayed ------- a technical problem.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 a technical problem，沒有動詞。2. 沒動詞＝介系詞。3. 選 because of。複習昨天的口訣：有動詞用連接詞，只有名詞用介系詞。

qs.stem: ------- the weather was cold, many people came to the festival.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 the weather was cold，有動詞 was。2. 刪掉介系詞 Despite、During、Because of。3. 選 Although。

qs.stem: Please do not use your phone ------- the presentation.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 the presentation，只有名詞。2. 選項中只有 during 是介系詞。3. 選 during。

qs.stem: We need an assistant ------- English skills are excellent.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後直接接名詞 English skills，再接動詞 are。2. 「助理『的』英文能力」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: The company is looking for a designer ------- can start next month.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後直接接動詞 can start。2. 缺主詞，先行詞是人（designer）。3. 選 who。

qs.stem: Many customers found the new menu ------- to read.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞（the new menu）+ 空格。2. 空格描述菜單的狀態（容易讀），用形容詞。3. 選 easy。和 keep your information safe 是同一個句型。

qs.stem: Visitors must comply ------- all safety rules in the factory.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：comply with ＝ 遵守，固定搭配。選 with。今天第四天出現，答對了就代表記住了。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（How long、front desk、NOT），再回原文找那一句。數日期時要看清楚起訖日。
passage: The elevator in the East Building will be closed for maintenance from Monday, November 9, to Wednesday, November 11.
During this time, please use the stairs or the elevator in the West Building. Staff who need help moving heavy items should contact the front desk at extension 210.
We are sorry for any inconvenience. The elevator will open again on Thursday morning.

qs.stem: What is the notice mainly about?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 看標題 Elevator Maintenance 和第一句 will be closed for maintenance。2. 關三天 ＝ temporary（暫時的）closure。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: How long will the elevator be closed?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找日期：November 9 到 November 11。2. 9、10、11 三天。3. 選 C。注意 Thursday morning 已經重新開放，不算在內。

qs.stem: Why would staff contact the front desk?
opts: To get help carrying heavy items
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找 front desk：Staff who need help moving heavy items should contact the front desk。2. moving heavy items 換句話說成 carrying heavy items。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the notice?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：NOT 題逐一回原文打勾。A：the elevator in the West Building，有。B：Thursday morning，有。C：extension 210，有。D：費用完全沒提，選 D。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: Didn't／Isn't 開頭的否定疑問句，把 not 拿掉再理解；Why don't you／we 是建議，刪掉 Because；聽到 or 就刪掉 Yes 開頭的選項。

qs.stem: Didn't you send the invoice yesterday?
opts: Yes, I sent it in the morning.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Did you send the invoice yesterday?（你昨天寄了嗎？）。2. A「有，早上寄了」，對應。3. B 是 invoice／voice 字音陷阱；C 重複 send。

qs.stem: Isn't the cafeteria open today?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 當成 Is the cafeteria open today?。2. A「沒開，在清潔」，對應。3. B 重複 open；C 用 cafe／cafeteria 字形陷阱。

qs.stem: Why don't we order lunch from the new restaurant?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't we…? ＝ 提議「我們要不要……」。2. 回應提議：Sure, I'll get the menu。3. 先刪 Because 開頭的 A。

qs.stem: Why don't you call the client first?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't you…? 是建議。2. OK, I'll do that now ＝ 接受建議。3. B 有 Because，刪；C 重複 client，刪。

qs.stem: Should we meet in your office or mine?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 聽到 or ＝ 選擇疑問句，先刪 Yes 開頭的 A。2. Mine is bigger ＝ 選「我的辦公室」（間接選擇）。3. C 回答時間，不是地點。

qs.stem: Would you like tea or coffee?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 有 or，先刪 Yes。2. Neither ＝ 兩個都不要，也是正確的回答方式。3. C 回答地點，不對。

sections.heading: Part 3 兩人對話（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 problem、caused、man do。女生說問題，男生說原因和解決方法，聽到 I'll 就是「他會做什麼」的答案。
script: W: Hi, I ordered a printer from your online store last week, but it still hasn't arrived.
M: I'm sorry about that. Can I have your order number, please?
M: Thank you. It looks like the printer was sent to your old address. I'll send a new one today by express delivery, at no extra cost.

qs.stem: What is the woman's problem?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 問題題聽女生第一句：it still hasn't arrived。2. hasn't arrived ＝ 選項 has not arrived。3. 選 B。C 是常見誘答：對話沒說壞掉。

qs.stem: What caused the problem?
opts: The printer was out of stock.
The item was sent to an old address.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 聽男生查詢後的話：was sent to your old address。2. 選 C。D 是陷阱：她有給訂單號碼，但號碼沒問題。

qs.stem: What will the man do?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 「男生會做什麼」聽 I'll…：I'll send a new one today。2. a new one ＝ a new printer。3. 選 B。at no extra cost 是不加錢，不是退款，A 是陷阱。
